_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD', "starting_balance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_closed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_closed" IN (0, 1)), "color" INTEGER NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "category_groups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_group_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES category_groups (id), "is_hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_hidden" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NULL, "goal_type" TEXT NULL, "target_amount" INTEGER NULL, "target_date" TEXT NULL, "color" INTEGER NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "month" TEXT NOT NULL, "budgeted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("category_id", "month"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budget_templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "data" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payees" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "auto_category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "default_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "created_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "color" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payee_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES payees (id), "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "memo" TEXT NULL, "cleared" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "approved" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("approved" IN (0, 1)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "transfer_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "transfer_transaction_id" TEXT NULL, "parent_transaction_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "created_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "report_notes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scheduled_transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "payee_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES payees (id), "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "amount" INTEGER NULL, "frequency" TEXT NULL, "interval" INTEGER NULL, "occurrence_count" INTEGER NULL, "next_date" TEXT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "auto_approve" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("auto_approve" IN (0, 1)), "memo" TEXT NULL, "anchor_day" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_sync_changes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "table_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "changed_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "old_updated_at" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "parsing_history" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "input" TEXT NOT NULL, "payee_id" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "parsing_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "keyword" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "payee_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "import_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "date_format" TEXT NOT NULL, "decimal_separator" TEXT NOT NULL, "outflow_is_negative" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("outflow_is_negative" IN (0, 1)), "date_column" TEXT NULL, "amount_column" TEXT NULL, "payee_column" TEXT NULL, "memo_column" TEXT NULL, "category_column" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "match_logic" TEXT NOT NULL, "conditions" TEXT NOT NULL, "actions" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_device_progress" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("device_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_kv" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_row_versions" ("sync_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sequence" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("sync_table", "row_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_conflicts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "sync_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "remote_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "remote_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "resolved_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_quarantine" ("filename" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "error" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "first_seen" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_attempt" TEXT NOT NULL, "next_attempt" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("filename"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_applying" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_budgets_month ON budgets (month)
CREATE INDEX idx_transactions_account ON transactions (account_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_transactions_date ON transactions (date)
CREATE INDEX idx_transactions_category ON transactions (category_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_transactions_payee ON transactions (payee_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_payees_name ON payees (name)
CREATE INDEX idx_payees_is_favorite ON payees (is_favorite)
CREATE INDEX idx_pending_sync_record ON pending_sync_changes (table_name, record_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_sync_row_versions_deleted ON sync_row_versions (deleted, version)
